payload=json.load(__import__("sys").stdin);owner=payload["owner"]

out=os.memfd_create("gpu0_identity",os.MFD_CLOEXEC);err=os.memfd_create("gpu0_identity_err",os.MFD_CLOEXEC)

if rc==0:
 fields=[x.strip() for x in raw.strip().split(",")];assert len(fields)==3 and fields[0]=="0" and fields[1]=="GPU-958e741a-e5cf-127e-ffe8-9b984e1f404c";r.update(uuid=fields[1],free_memory_mib=int(fields[2]),identity_matched=True)
